subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words in the given sentence.

The war resulted in ruthless __killing of many people__.
solution:
The correct answer is **“Carnage**”.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term "carnage" directly refers to the mass killing or slaughter of a large number of people, typically in the context of a battle or a conflict. This makes it the most appropriate one-word substitute for the phrase "killing of many people" within the context of the given sentence.
 
• "Carnage" aptly captures the brutality implied in the phrase "killing of many people", emphasizing not just the act of killing, but the aftermath and the scale, which is key to understanding the severe consequences of the war mentioned in the sentence.

Hence, the correct answer is ‘**Option 3’.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let’s have a look at the meaning of the remaining options.
 
• **Sacrilege **is the violation or misuse of what is regarded as sacred. (पवित्र की अवहेलना)
 
• **Fratricide **refers to the act of killing one's own brother or sister. (भ्रातृहत्या)
 
• **Murder **is the unlawful premeditated killing of one human being by another. (हत्या)
